title: Toll-Scrip Urchins
text: A knot of soot-faced lane children flashes counterfeit toll charms and tries to cut your salvage straps.
flavor: The smallest gangs know which pockets matter.

defeatReward.text: You spot the false toll mark and learn which stalls are running the trick.
